The present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks grant of parole for a period of sixty days in FIR No. 248/2010, registered under Sections 506, 365 and 376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 25, 27, 54 and 59 of the Arms Act, 1959 at P.S. Dhaula Kuan.
Mr. Sanjay Lao, Standing Counsel for the State, accepts notice.
3. Status Report, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
4. Nominal Roll be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/11/2025 at 23:33:09 5.
Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent, for necessary information and compliance.
